allow:
Bash(/tmp/fix_stop_calls.sh <<'EOF'
#!/bin/bash
# Fix .Stop() calls to add context.Background()

# For each .go file
find . -name "*.go" -type f | while read file; do
    # Skip if file doesn't contain .Stop()
    if ! grep -q '\.Stop()' "$file"; then
        continue
    fi
    
    # Add context import if not present and file has Stop() calls needing it
    if grep -q 'err.*\.Stop()' "$file" || grep -q ':=.*\.Stop()' "$file" || grep -q 'if.*\.Stop()' "$file"; then
        if ! grep -q '"context"' "$file"; then
            # Try to add context import
            sed -i '' '/^import ($/a\
	"context"
' "$file" 2>/dev/null || true
        fi
    fi
    
    # Replace various .Stop() patterns
    sed -i '' -E 's/([a-zA-Z_][a-zA-Z0-9_]*)\.Stop\(\)/\1.Stop(context.Background())/g' "$file"
done

echo "Fixed Stop() calls"
EOF)
